IoT Solutions
IoT devices can automate tasks, improve efficiency, and provide convenience. The Internet of Things(IoT) refers to a network of physical objects-often called things-that are embedded with sensors, software, and other technologies to connect and exchange data with other devices and systems over the internet.

Research & Development
Research and Development (R&D) represents the process of learning, experimenting, and innovating to create new technologies and improve existing ones. At Nexonica, R&D enables us to stay ahead in the fast-changing tech landscape by blending research-based insights with real-world application.
Nexonica's Industrial Training is not just about learning - it's about transforming potential into performance. Participants work on live projects, interact with industry experts, and experience the full software development lifecycle.
Training is typically designed to teach new skills or knowledge to employees, while internships are designed to provide hands-on experience to students or recent graduates. Training is a process of learning new skills or knowledge, usually in a formal setting such as a classroom or training center.
